title: Amateur Sports League
description: Five people in a recreational basketball league in Denver, Colorado, connected through their team, workplaces, family ties, and shared hobbies. Mix of professions, ages, and backgrounds.

people.name: Omar Hadid
people.role: Team coach and emergency room physician
people.profile: Lebanese-American, grew up in Dearborn, Michigan. ER doctor at Denver Health. Coaches the rec league basketball team 'Mile High Mavericks' and is a devoted father of two.

observations.text: Omar Hadid coaches the Mile High Mavericks, a recreational basketball team in the Denver Parks & Rec league.
Omar Hadid works as an emergency room physician at Denver Health Medical Center, usually on the 7 AM to 7 PM shift.
Omar Hadid grew up in Dearborn, Michigan, and moved to Denver in 2015 for his residency.
Omar Hadid and Kenji Watanabe work together at Denver Health, with Kenji in the radiology department.
Omar Hadid earned his M.D. from the University of Michigan Medical School in 2013.
Omar Hadid's wife, Layla, is a pediatric dentist with her own practice on Colorado Boulevard.
Omar Hadid has two children: a 7-year-old daughter named Noor and a 4-year-old son named Zain.
Omar Hadid played point guard on the University of Michigan club basketball team from 2007 to 2011.
Omar Hadid organized a charity basketball tournament in July 2024 at the Stapleton Recreation Center that raised $8,200 for the Denver Rescue Mission.
Omar Hadid drives a black 2023 Audi Q7.
Omar Hadid's mother, Fatima, runs a Lebanese bakery called Cedar House Bakery in Dearborn.
Omar Hadid lives in a four-bedroom house in the Park Hill neighborhood that he bought in 2018 for $485,000.
Omar Hadid speaks English, Arabic, and basic Spanish that he learned for patient communication.
Omar Hadid skis at Breckenridge every other weekend during winter, usually on the blue runs with his daughter Noor.
Omar Hadid led the Mile High Mavericks to win the Denver Parks & Rec summer league championship in August 2024.
Omar Hadid cooks his mother's kibbeh recipe for the team's post-game dinners at his house.
Omar Hadid published a case study on sports-related concussion protocols in the Journal of Emergency Medicine in March 2024.
Omar Hadid and Tessa Brandt are neighbors in the Park Hill neighborhood, living three houses apart on Dahlia Street.
Omar Hadid volunteers at the Denver Free Clinic on the first Saturday of every month.
Omar Hadid's favorite Denver restaurant is Safta, a modern Israeli restaurant at the Source Market Hall.

people.name: Tessa Brandt
people.role: Brewery owner and team power forward
people.profile: German-American, born in Denver. Owns a craft brewery in RiNo. Former college basketball player at Colorado State. The team's most competitive player.

observations.text: Tessa Brandt owns and operates Summit Line Brewing in Denver's RiNo Art District, which she opened in October 2021.
Tessa Brandt was born and raised in Denver, Colorado, and grew up in the Highlands neighborhood.
Tessa Brandt played power forward on the Colorado State University women's basketball team from 2009 to 2013.
Tessa Brandt and Omar Hadid are neighbors in the Park Hill neighborhood, living three houses apart on Dahlia Street.
Tessa Brandt and Kenji Watanabe are in the same Saturday morning trail running group that meets at Red Rocks Park at 7 AM.
Tessa Brandt earned a degree in Food Science from Colorado State University in 2013.
Tessa Brandt's flagship beer, 'Fourteener Fog', a hazy IPA, won a silver medal at the Great American Beer Festival in 2023.
Tessa Brandt drives a white 2021 Ford Bronco.
Tessa Brandt's father, Klaus, is a retired mechanical engineer who helped her build the brewery's custom fermentation tanks.
Tessa Brandt hiked all 58 of Colorado's fourteeners, completing the last one, Little Bear Peak, in September 2023.
Tessa Brandt hosts the Mile High Mavericks' post-game happy hours at Summit Line Brewing every Tuesday after practice.
Tessa Brandt has a border collie named Barley who comes to the brewery every day.
Tessa Brandt scored 22 points in the summer league championship game in August 2024, including three consecutive three-pointers.
Tessa Brandt speaks English and conversational German, which she learned from her grandparents.
Tessa Brandt expanded Summit Line Brewing's taproom in January 2024, adding a 40-seat outdoor patio with mountain views.
Tessa Brandt's younger sister Maren is a ski instructor at Vail Resort.
Tessa Brandt volunteers as a basketball coach for the Girls Inc. of Metro Denver program on Saturday afternoons.
Tessa Brandt ran the Leadville Trail 100 ultramarathon in August 2024, finishing in 27 hours 14 minutes.
Tessa Brandt's favorite book is 'The Overstory' by Richard Powers.
Tessa Brandt partnered with local artist Diego Solis to create a 30-foot mural on the brewery's north wall.

people.name: Kenji Watanabe
people.profile: Japanese-American, from Seattle. Works at Denver Health. Avid photographer and trail runner. The team's best three-point shooter.

observations.text: Kenji Watanabe works as a radiologist at Denver Health Medical Center in the diagnostic imaging department.
Kenji Watanabe grew up in Seattle, Washington, and moved to Denver in 2019.
Kenji Watanabe earned his M.D. from the University of Washington School of Medicine in 2016.
Kenji Watanabe and Omar Hadid work together at Denver Health, Omar in the ER and Kenji in radiology.
Kenji Watanabe and Tessa Brandt are in the same Saturday morning trail running group that meets at Red Rocks Park at 7 AM.
Kenji Watanabe and Darius Coleman play in a weekly poker game every Wednesday night at Darius's apartment.
Kenji Watanabe shoots landscape photography and had a gallery show at the Denver Art Society's Globeville space in June 2024.
Kenji Watanabe has the best three-point shooting percentage on the Mile High Mavericks at 42%.
Kenji Watanabe lives in a loft apartment in the LoHi neighborhood on Platte Street.
Kenji Watanabe's father, Hiroshi, is a retired Boeing aerospace engineer in Seattle.
Kenji Watanabe drives a gray 2022 Subaru Crosstrek.
Kenji Watanabe completed the Rim-to-Rim hike of the Grand Canyon in 14 hours 20 minutes in October 2023.
Kenji Watanabe's older sister Yoko is a marine biologist at the Monterey Bay Aquarium in California.
Kenji Watanabe uses a Sony A7R V camera body with a 24-70mm f/2.8 GM lens for his landscape photography.
Kenji Watanabe speaks English and Japanese fluently.
Kenji Watanabe ran the Denver Colfax Marathon in May 2024 with a time of 3 hours 28 minutes.
Kenji Watanabe adopted a gray tabby cat named Pixel from the Denver Dumb Friends League in April 2024.
Kenji Watanabe volunteers as a health screener at the Asian Pacific Development Center in Aurora on the third Saturday of each month.
Kenji Watanabe's favorite ramen spot in Denver is Uncle, a ramen shop on Larimer Street.
Kenji Watanabe sold a print of his photograph 'Maroon Bells at Dawn' for $1,200 at the Cherry Creek Arts Festival.

people.name: Darius Coleman
people.role: Music producer and team point guard
people.profile: African-American, born in Denver. Runs a home recording studio. The youngest player on the team and its fastest ball handler. Darius is Omar's wife's younger cousin.

observations.text: Darius Coleman runs a home recording studio called Black Anvil Studios out of his apartment in the Five Points neighborhood.
Darius Coleman was born and raised in Denver's Five Points neighborhood.
Darius Coleman graduated from the University of Colorado Denver with a B.A. in Music Industry Studies in 2019.
Darius Coleman and Kenji Watanabe play in a weekly poker game every Wednesday night at Darius's apartment.
Darius Coleman is Omar Hadid's wife Layla's younger cousin, which is how he joined the Mile High Mavericks.
Darius Coleman and Lucia Vega take a hip-hop dance class at the Cleo Parker Robinson Dance Ensemble studio every Thursday evening.
Darius Coleman produced a 12-track album for Denver rapper Kaia Monroe that reached 500,000 streams on Spotify by March 2024.
Darius Coleman plays point guard for the Mile High Mavericks and led the league in assists with 8.3 per game in the 2024 summer season.
Darius Coleman's mother, Patricia, is a high school principal at Manual High School in Five Points.
Darius Coleman's father, Jerome, is a retired Denver firefighter who served for 28 years at Station 3.
Darius Coleman drives a midnight blue 2020 Dodge Charger.
Darius Coleman DJs at the Meadowlark Bar on East Colfax every other Saturday night under the name 'DJ Anvil'.
Darius Coleman taught himself to play piano at age 9 on a secondhand Yamaha upright his grandmother gave him.
Darius Coleman won Best Producer at the Denver Hip Hop Awards in November 2023.
Darius Coleman volunteers as a music mentor at the Youth on Record program in Denver, teaching beat production to teenagers.
Darius Coleman's favorite restaurant is Welton Street Cafe, where he orders the chicken and waffles every Sunday morning.
Darius Coleman adopted a pit bull mix named Sub Bass from the Denver Animal Shelter in June 2024.
Darius Coleman built his recording studio using $15,000 in savings and soundproofed it with acoustic foam panels he installed himself.
Darius Coleman's older brother, Marcus Coleman, is a staff sergeant in the U.S. Army stationed at Fort Carson.
Darius Coleman scored the game-winning three-pointer with 4 seconds left in the summer league semifinal game against the Cherry Creek Coyotes.

people.name: Lucia Vega
people.profile: Mexican-American, born in El Paso, Texas. Practices immigration law in Denver. At 6'1", she plays center for the co-ed rec league team. Active in Denver's Latino community.

observations.text: Lucia Vega works as an immigration attorney at Rocky Mountain Legal Aid on Broadway in Denver.
Lucia Vega was born in El Paso, Texas, and moved to Denver in 2020 after law school.
Lucia Vega earned her J.D. from the University of New Mexico School of Law in 2020, graduating summa cum laude.
Lucia Vega and Darius Coleman take a hip-hop dance class at the Cleo Parker Robinson Dance Ensemble studio every Thursday evening.
Lucia Vega and Omar Hadid volunteer together at the Denver Free Clinic on the first Saturday of every month.
Lucia Vega plays center for the Mile High Mavericks at 6 feet 1 inch tall, the tallest player on the team.
Lucia Vega played basketball at El Paso High School, where she was named All-District in 2011 and 2012.
Lucia Vega won the Colorado Lawyers Committee Pro Bono Award in April 2024 for handling 47 asylum cases.
Lucia Vega's mother, Carmen, is a retired schoolteacher in El Paso who now runs a small tamale catering business called Carmen's Cocina.
Lucia Vega lives in a one-bedroom apartment in the Baker neighborhood on South Broadway.
Lucia Vega drives a red 2021 Jeep Wrangler.
Lucia Vega speaks English and Spanish fluently, and is learning Portuguese through a Duolingo streak of 487 days.
Lucia Vega organized a know-your-rights workshop for the Latino community at the Denver Central Library in September 2024 that drew 120 attendees.
Lucia Vega's older brother, Mateo, is a firefighter with the El Paso Fire Department.
Lucia Vega hikes with her rescue dog, a husky named Justice, at Waterton Canyon every Sunday.
Lucia Vega's favorite Denver restaurant is Los Chingones on East Colfax, where she orders the street tacos al pastor.
Lucia Vega completed a 200-hour yoga teacher training at Kindness Yoga in Denver in February 2024.
Lucia Vega scored a double-double with 14 points and 12 rebounds in the summer league championship game.
Lucia Vega reads legal thrillers and her favorite is 'The Lincoln Lawyer' by Michael Connelly.
Lucia Vega was featured in a Denver Post article about young immigration lawyers making a difference, published in June 2024.

chain_examples.k5_example: Omar -> Tessa (neighbors in Park Hill) -> Kenji (trail running partners) -> Darius (weekly poker buddies) -> Lucia (dance class partners) -> Omar (volunteer clinic partners). This is a 5-hop chain traversing all 5 people and returning to the start.
